content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-65. - Exceptions.
content.summary:

             …

faqs.a:
Noise caused in the maintenance, construction, repair, or improvement of any public
               road or public facility by public employees, by any person acting pursuant to a public
               works contract, or by any person acting under the direction or control of an employee
               of any public agency, shall be exempt from the provisions of this chapter. Property
               owners doing maintenance of their property for purposes of safety and compliance with
               the Arvada City Code are exempt from the provisions of this chapter as long as the
               noise is reasonable based on the work being completed and the noise level remains
               within the permissible levels found at
section 38-91
.
(Code 1981, § 19-15; Ord. No. 3171, § 3, 3-20-1995; Ord. No.
4789
, § 2, 12-6-2021)
